SELECT * FROM ( SELECT i.id, i.tenant_id, i.create_id, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.process_id, i.priority, i.urgent, i.instance_no, i.business_key, i.current_node_name, i.current_node_key, i.variable, 0 AS instance_state, NULL AS end_time FROM flw_instance i
JOIN flw_process p ON p.id = i.process_id
WHERE 1=1 AND i.create_id = #{startUserId} AND i.process_id = #{processDefinitionId} AND p.process_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{processName}, '%') AND i.business_key = #{businessKey}
AND i.variable LIKE CONCAT('%"__title":"%', #{title}, '%') ESCAPE '|'
AND i.priority = #{priority} UNION ALL SELECT h.id, h.tenant_id, h.create_id, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.process_id, h.priority, h.urgent, h.instance_no, h.business_key, h.current_node_name, h.current_node_key, h.variable, h.instance_state, h.end_time FROM flw_his_instance h
JOIN flw_process p2 ON p2.id = h.process_id
WHERE h.instance_state > 0 AND h.create_id = #{startUserId} AND h.process_id = #{processDefinitionId} AND p2.process_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{processName}, '%') AND h.business_key = #{businessKey}
AND h.variable LIKE CONCAT('%"__title":"%', #{title}, '%') ESCAPE '|'
AND h.priority = #{priority} ) merged
ORDER BY merged.priority DESC, merged.create_time DESC
ORDER BY merged.create_time DESC
